3.title: hiya!
3.body:
ive been recovering from this weekend, ive been extremely low energy recently, not sure why, probably bc of moving soon. SO fucking excited about whats falling into place though. i will admit here and now im using chatgpt to help me learn html code and i will stand by that decision. i will use the tools i have to better myself, i do not give a fuck. that and the voice feature make it very accessible. i see that as using it for what its for - avoiding the boring tedious intricacies of something like understanding how to impliment something with html code. but honestly its kind of a cool experience bc even with it doing a lot of the work for me for the website, im still picking up a lot just having to work with it and will definitely be able to not use it at a certain point. but im honestly thankful to live in an age with resources like we have right now, even tho i fear death every day in this chungus country. hope u understand me using my droid for good -- fr might see if theres a local model i can install to help me with rlly mundane stuff and handling my own stuff i feed it. we'll see. idk. i just really dont want to waste my time reinventing the wheel if theres an easy way to make my stuff easily accessible available to me. idk if its weird to write a book on that but i take ai very seriously and want to make sure im being transparent about it. being able to have the voice feature is genuinely very helpful in terms of accessibility. i would never be able to make it through youtube tutorials or forums about this and it makes it much more of a direct learning process. idk if ill be able to turn down its usage for learning, not atm at least. - this is so messy and im not fixing it

4.title: I love being a girl
4.body:
Last night i attended @epiphanyproductionspresents (on insta) drag show. it was underscores themed, specifically the wallsocket album. i vividly remember walking down morse street in rogers park west almost to clark, hearing horror movie soundtrack play in my earbuds in the summer of 2023. i did not understand this album when i first heard it. its all so laughably predictable, but now hearing it recontextualized after socially transitioning was a moving experience. there were many moments when i cried. the performance was amazing and im very thankful to have been invited

i met Lady Piphany when i received a DM from her saying that she found my Snel destiny swap card. i specifically remember having a difficult time letting go of that card, because i was so happy with how it turned out, and how it felt. i left it in a library, shortly after found by lady piphany.

She was kind enough to show my music video for Kinda Heavy Ivory Version as an opening to the show, and it was a very surreal experience to hear the words that were once coming to me while slowly meditatively walking across the beach now resonating in a dark room with stage lights and a room full of wallsocket fans. i am deeply thankful to feel in some way that i am contributing to a very important conversation. i hope i can continue to trust my voice and make things im scared of. i was thinking of underscores when making the music video, and it is like sweet honey that this has come from it. so so thankful.

i continue to be a little overwhelmed with how much stuff im making and trying to keep up with putting it all out there. ive been writing a TON recently, and a lot is coming together. all in time

all that said. Lady Piphany said a lot of very nice words at the opening of the show, but what stands out in my mind is that the most meaningful thing for me was being called "she" very loudly in front of everyone. it made me so happy. i was(am) a girl. its so stupid. its so small. so simple. but the simple small things are what demonstrate we understand. sometimes a slight shift of weight, can mean more than 100 words.

i think the common misunderstanding of becoming "triggered" when being misgendered grossly misrepresents how subtle the despair of dysphoria is. i dont feel anything when someone misgenders me other than disappointment, and discouragement. a confirmation that the world i fear does not accept me indeed does not accept me. its boring. its sad. its nothing. it shows that people have the capacity to walk this life as robots, empty, and non feeling. the evidence of this capacity makes it difficult to believe the version of the world where i belong is the real one. and the most painful part of this experience for me, is i just forget. i get into this ruts where i literally forget what the euphoria feels like and i get stuck in a hole of being depressed and not knowing why. the notable experience is the euphoria, not the dysphoria. the dysphoria is the first "normal" i ever understood. the euphoria, even though it is heaven, it is strange and scary and unfamiliar compared to the ocean of empty dull grey unsettling unbearable dissonance in the back of my ribs. this feeling in the back of my ribs tells me something that is easy to believe: "i am invisible". 

euphoria, when it shines its scalding light, screams "you never had to believe that". it is always very painful for me in a way to experience the best thing ive felt yet. im always horryfied that it will not stay around. the ocean of dispair finds me, and the only land i have is the islands of small moments where i feel alive. i have felt alive this week. i am a girl :3 

wallsocket puts so many feelings that are impossible to say into sound. it reminded me that other people are feeling what i feel.

dunno if this is tmi, tbqh idc.
